summary: Source evidence fully satisfies operator clarity. public/app.js shows the full count (“This download contains … matching customers.”), active scope (“Filters: …”), columns (“Exported columns: …”), and distinguishes the sample from the full file (“Sample: first five matching records. The complete CSV download contains all …”). public/index.html provides unambiguous “Download complete CSV,” “Cancel,” and “Close export preview” actions. The no-match state says the CSV contains only column headers. public/app.js snapshots one query for preview and download, removes the download link while loading, rejects superseded responses, and invalidates the preview on filter changes or closure, preventing stale-query downloads. src/export.mjs derives count and first-five sample from the same unpaginated matches used by export. Current npm test passed 13/13. No rendered-browser behavior is claimed; the supplied notes explicitly state it was not observed.
